title_zh: 拉萨市人民代表大会常务委员会批准任免名单
title_en: Lhasa Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Approves Appointment and Removal List
summary_zh: 2026年9月1日，拉萨市第十二届人民代表大会常务委员会第三十八次会议通过批准任免名单。
summary_en: On September 1, 2026, the 38th session of the Standing Committee of the 12th Lhasa Municipal People's Congress approved the appointment and removal list.
